Prevention: Dig or plough around pomegranate tree immediately after harvest to expose the pupae to predatory birds, other natural enemies and the sun.
Removal of weeds and plants which serve as alternate hosts.
Collection and destruction (by burying) of damaged fruits away from the field.
Polythene bag or butter paper when fruits attain lemon size (30-40 days after fruit set).
Monitoring: Use of light trap @ 1/acre to monitor the activity of adults.
Observe the eggs on fruit calyx (flower) @ 5 eggs/plant.
Direct Control: Trichogramma chilonis @ one lakh (5 cc)/acre at the time of flowering.
Azadirachtin 1500 ppm @ 3.0 ml/litre of water at 15 days intervals commencing from initiation of flowering up to the harvesting subjected to the presence of fruit borer
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators
Spray any one of the following chemicals:
Cypermethrin 25% EC (1 ml/ litre) at fortnightly interval from flowering to fruit development.
